issues.rootCause: Canvas AA coverage threshold>=128 represents pixel area, while the legacy aliased clip has different edge membership and integer pointer coordinates.

issues.fix: Floor/deduplicate lasso inputs, compute bbox inline without spread arrays; pure polygonMask uses aliased scan conversion and binary1B/pixel mask consumed consistently by lift/source-preview/source-clear.

issues.trigger: Nearest resize lands exactly between source pixels, e.g.2→3.
issues.rootCause: The prior center Math.round tie chose the upper index; Qt FastTransformation chooses the lower one.
issues.reproduction: Core baseline fails at2→1; public eight-case suite isolates6 nearest stage failures using observed initial payload independently of mask errors.
issues.fix: Use ceil(center)-1 in existing nearest branch. Preserve raw RGBA and metadata; smooth resize is unchanged. Existing clipboard expectation now uses literal Qt20→30 and20→25 maps rather than the old center formula.

issues.rootCause: UI passed the whole selection rect to a generic crop API whose intentional contract pads outside bounds. Legacy UI crops the pending document intersection.
issues.reproduction: Same final test baseline1PASS/3FAIL. Partial rect/lasso produced10×8 instead of7×6. Fully outside committed10×8 and discarded Redo instead of retaining pending NoOp.
issues.fix: Clip only the UI crop request to its nonnegative pending intersection, return before edit on empty intersection. Generic cropState padding API and tests remain intact.

architecture.engineAlgorithmAdded: polygonMask in existing engine/operations.ts. A real pixel-ownership algorithm shared by DOM integration, Node and WK validation; no statement-sized helper/new module/service introduced.
architecture.stateFlow: Floored pointer path→binary mask→straight-RGBA/key selection→owned resize/copy candidate→clear original source mask and clip destination→validate/prepare→commit. Cancel/failure retains prior document/Redo; unmodified selection is NoOp.
architecture.internalMask: sourceMask RGBA4*S→Uint8Array S. Original source stride stays tied to source width after selected payload resize. Lifted source pixels4*S remain; explicit initial pixel+mask storage8*S→5*S plus O(path points/edges), not an RSS bound.
